newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: BP launches Colombian solar power unit.
newsitem.headline: BP launches Colombian solar power unit.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc launched Wednesday a Colombian unit of its solar power operations -- BP Solar Latinoamerica.

The Bogota-based unit of BP Solar, that currently operates in 18 countries, employs just 10 people at present. The spokesman was unable to give any estimate of the future investment plan of the company.
BP Solar Latinoamerica is currently carrying out a pilot solar energy project in eastern Casanare province close to the site of BP's oil production operations.
At the launch John Doust, chairman of BP's main Colombian unit, BP Exploration, said Colombia had been chosen as the launch pad for the company's drive into the regional solar energy market.
